sanskrit_prose: श्रुतवृत्तान्ताः दिग्भ्यः अपि प्राप्ताः जानपदाः जनाः तदा एवं विधम् पौराणाम् कथयताम् शुश्रुवुः
english_sloka: The crowd heard Paul say a number of things.
english_prose: Those who had been healed by the spirits heard Paul's story and the parable.

sanskrit_sloka: किं मां वक्ष्यति सुग्रीवो हरयो वा समागताः किष्किन्धां समनुप्राप्तं तौ वा दशरथात्मजौ
sanskrit_prose: किष्किन्धाम् समनुप्राप्तम् माम् सुग्रीवः किम् वक्ष्यति समागताः हरयः वा तौ दशरथात्मजौ वा

sanskrit_sloka: खड्गधाराहता मेऽद्य दीप्यमाना इवाद्रयःपतिष्यन्ति द्विपा भूमौ मेघा इव सविद्युतः
sanskrit_prose: अद्य हया: मे खङ्गधाराहताः दीप्यमानाः अद्रय इव सविद्युतः मेघा इव भूमौ पतिष्यन्ति
english_sloka: The lampstands in my hand will shine like a cloud on the earth.
english_prose: "In the day of judgment, those with bright lights will be like thunderbolts, like clouds of lightning.

sanskrit_sloka: तदवश्यं त्वया कार्यस्ससुहृत्सुहृदां वरअकृत्वा हि न ते सिद्धिमहं पश्यामि चिन्तयन्
sanskrit_prose: सुहृदाम् वर तत् सः त्वया अवश्यम् सुहृत् कार्यः अकृत्वा ते सिद्धिम् अहम् चिन्तयन् न पश्यामि
english_sloka: For they did not find me perfect in your work, because you gave them the strength to do so.
english_prose: Surely he has done a good work for you, but I do not find it complete.

sanskrit_sloka: स्वपुरं चागमच्छ्रीमानिष्टयज्ञोमहीपति: गङ्गायाश्चागमे राजा निश्चयं नाध्यगच्छत
sanskrit_prose: श्रीमान् महीपति: इष्टयज्ञ: स्वपुरम् आगमत् राजा गङ्गाया: आगमे निश्चयम् नाध्यगच्छत
english_sloka: And when the king came to his palace, he saw the king, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants, and the king's servants.
english_prose: Richman Mahipati: Ishtaiah: The King of Ganga has come to his palace: The coming of the King of Ganga has certainly not come.

sanskrit_sloka: नाहमस्मिन् प्रभुः कार्ये वानरेश न लक्ष्मणःत्वमस्य हेतुः कार्यस्य प्रभुश्च प्लवगेश्वर
sanskrit_prose: प्लवगेश्वर वानरेश अहम् अस्मिन् कार्ये प्रभुः न लक्ष्मणः न त्वम् अस्य कार्यस्य हेतुः प्रभुश्च
english_sloka: For we are not the Lord's doing, nor the serpent's doing, but the Lord's doing, and God's doing.
english_prose: It is not the Lord who commands us to do this, nor is it you, but it is the Lord who commands us to do this.

sanskrit_sloka: हा हन्ताऽस्मि नृशंसोऽहं यत्सभार्यः कृते ममईदृशीं राघवश्शय्यामधिशेते ह्यनाथवत्
sanskrit_prose: हा हन्त अहम् नृशंसः अस्मि यत् मम कृते राघवः सभार्यः अनाथवत् ईदृशीम् शय्याम् अधिशेते
english_sloka: I am a man of sorrows and acquainted with grief.
english_prose: "I am afraid that the ravens will put such a bed on me as an orphan.

sanskrit_sloka: ददर्शान्तरंतस्यविरूपाक्षस्यवानरः ततोन्यपातयत्क्रोधाच्छङ्खदेशेमहात्तलम्
sanskrit_prose: सःवानरः तस्यविरूपाक्षस्य अन्तरम् ददर्श ततः क्रोधात् अन्यत् महात्तलम् शङ्खदेशे पातयत्
english_sloka: When they saw him, the man with the right hand fell down and fell into a deep pit.
english_prose: When he saw a hole in his arm, he was furious and threw another chain into his throat.

sanskrit_sloka: पीड्यमानांसधर्मात्मावैदेहीमनुचिन्तयन् क्षिप्रमाज्ञापयामासवानरान्द्विषतांवधे
sanskrit_prose: धर्मात्मा स: पीड्यमानां वैदेहीम अचिन्तयन् क्षिप्रमाज्ञापयामास वानरान् द्विषतां वधे
english_sloka: The spirit of godly devotion comforted the afflicted and helped them to obey for a little while.
english_prose: God's Spirit chose the afflicted among them. He gave them a little instruction, and the serpent began to speak in their mouths.

sanskrit_sloka: अमोघंदर्शनंराम तवास्माकंनरर्षभ प्रीतियुक्ताःस्मतेनत्वंब्रूहियन्मनसेप्सितम्
sanskrit_prose: नरर्षभ राम तव अस्माकम् दर्शनम् अमोघम् प्रीतियुक्ताः स्म तेन मनसा यत् ईप्सितम् त्वम् ब्रूहि
english_sloka: Our hearts are filled with joy because of you, our beloved.
english_prose: When he came to see us, he told us how much he loved us. He thought he was very fond of you.

sanskrit_sloka: अपश्यंस्तु ततस्तत्र पितरं पितुरालयेजगाम भरतो द्रष्टुं मातरं मातुरालये
sanskrit_prose: ततः भरतः तत्र पितुः आलये पितरम् अपश्यन् मातुः आलये मातरम् द्रष्टुम् जगाम
english_sloka: When he saw Peter and his mother coming out of the synagogue,
english_prose: When they got up, they saw Peter in his father's manger and his mother in her manger.

sanskrit_sloka: तं वाली क्रोधताम्राक्षस्सुग्रीवं रणपण्डितम्आपतन्तं महावेगमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
sanskrit_prose: वाली क्रोधताम्राक्षः रणपण्डितम् महावेगम् आपतन्तम् तं सुग्रीवम् इदं वचनम् अब्रवीत्
english_sloka: And he spoke the word in a fury, and in a fury of anger, and in a fury of anger, and in a fury of anger.
english_prose: Then a furious fury and a furious fury came upon him.

sanskrit_sloka: ततो हलहलाशब्दस्तुमुलस्समजायत तस्य निष्क्रममाणस्य जनौघस्य समन्ततः
sanskrit_prose: ततः समन्ततः निष्क्रममाणस्य तस्य जनौघस्य तुमुलः हलहलाशब्दः समजायत
english_sloka: When they heard this, they shouted loudly at the sword of the people who were about to kill him.
english_prose: Immediately the crowd heard the sound of his voice.

sanskrit_sloka: न रामरामानुजशासनं त्वयाकपीन्द्र युक्तं मनसाऽप्यपोहितुम्मनो हि ते ज्ञास्यति मानुषं बलंस राघवस्यास्य सुरेन्द्रवर्चसः
sanskrit_prose: कपीन्द्र रामरामानुजशासनम् त्वया मनसापि अपोहितुम् न युक्तम् अस्य सराघवस्य सुरेन्द्रवर्चसः मानुषम् बलम् ते मनः ज्ञास्यति हि
english_sloka: They will know that it is not Rama Rama's rule that has brought you to the brink of extinction. They will know that man's strength is the sword's sword, and the sword's sword's sword is the sword's sword.
english_prose: They will know the strength of this palace, the strength of the human heart, and the power of this palace.

sanskrit_sloka: पारिखाःपूरयन्तिस्मप्रसन्नसलिलायुताः पांसुभिःपर्वताग्रैश्चतृणैःकाष्ठैश्चवानराः
sanskrit_prose: वानराः पारिखाः पर्वताग्रैश्च तृणैः काष्ठैश्च पांसुभिः प्रसन्नसलिलायुताः पूरयन्ति
english_sloka: We were filled with joy and gladness. We were filled with rocks and mountains and hills and mountains.
english_prose: And the wild beasts and the hills and the mountains and the grasslands and the hills and the valleys will be filled with glad tidings.

sanskrit_sloka: दीर्घिकाः पुष्करिण्यश्च नानावृक्षसमन्विताःरावणो दर्शयामास सीतां शोकपरायणाम्
sanskrit_prose: रावणः दीर्घिकाः नानावृक्षसमन्विताः पुष्करिण्यश्च शोकपरायणाम् सीताम् दर्शयामास
english_sloka: He showed them flowers and flowers and trees of various sizes.
english_prose: And Ravana showed her a sign of mourning, and a sign of many trees, and a sign of flowers, and a sign of mourning.

sanskrit_sloka: वमुक्तास्तुरामेणहरीन्द्राहरयस्तथा ऊचुःप्राञ्जलयस्सर्वेराक्षसश्चविभीषणः
sanskrit_prose: रामेण एवम् उक्ताः हरीन्द्राः तथा हरयः राक्षसः विभीषणश्च सर्वे प्राञ्जलयः ऊचुः
english_sloka: They were terrified by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet, and by the sound of the trumpet.
english_prose: These are the words of Rameh. The green beasts, the green beasts, the terrible beasts, all the windows are high.

sanskrit_sloka: यदिन्द्रो वर्षते वर्षं न तच्चित्रं भवेत्क्वचित्आदित्यो वा सहस्रांशुः कुर्याद्वितिमिरं नभः चन्द्रमा रश्मिभिः कुर्यात्पृथिवीं सौम्य निर्मलाम्त्वद्विधो वाऽपि मित्राणां प्रतिकुर्यात्परन्तप
sanskrit_prose: परन्तप सौम्य इन्द्रः वर्षम् यत् वर्षते सहस्रांशुः वा आदित्यः नभः वितिमिरम् कुर्यात् चन्द्रमाः पृथिवीं रश्मिभिः निर्मलाम् कुर्यात् त्वद्विधः मित्राणाम् प्रतिकुर्यात् तत् चित्रम् न भविष्यति
english_sloka: Even if it were a dry season or a dry year, or a thousand years of darkness, or a full moon, or a cloud, or a gloomy earth, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold winter, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or a cold, or
english_prose: But it will not be like a gentle rainy season, when a thousand years of rain will fall, and the sky will be darkened, and the moon will be darkened by the lights of the earth.

sanskrit_sloka: नेयं जरयितुं शक्या सासुरैरमरैरपिविषसंसृष्टमत्यर्थं भुक्तमन्नमिवौजसा
sanskrit_prose: अत्यर्थम् विषसंसृष्टम् भुक्तम् अन्नमिव इयम् सासुरैः अमरैरपि ओजसा जरयितुम् न शक्या
english_sloka: Do not eat food that is not edible or poisonous, but that which is poisonous or poisonous.
english_prose: They ate very poisonous food, and they could not keep burning their burdens forever.

sanskrit_sloka: सहसा लक्ष्मणः श्रीमान् नदीं गोदावरीं तदास्नात्वा पद्मानि चादाय सफलः पुनरागतः
sanskrit_prose: तदा श्रीमान् लक्ष्मणः सहसा गोदावरीं नदीम् गत्वा स्नात्वा पद्मानि च आदाय सफलः पुनः आगतः
english_sloka: The rich man of Laxman went down to the river and washed his feet, and came back successfully to Padma.
english_prose: So the rich man went down to the river, washed his clothes, and came back with good luck.

sanskrit_sloka: तस्यान्तरिक्षेचरतःसरथस्यमहायशः न गतिर्ज्ञायतेवीरसूर्यस्येवाभ्रसम्ल्पवे
sanskrit_prose: महायशः वीर सरथस्य अन्तरिक्षे चरतः तस्य गतिः अभ्रसम्प्लवे सूर्यस्येव न ज्ञायते
english_sloka: The sun shines brightly on the earth, and the sun shines brightly on the earth's surface.
english_prose: A mighty warrior walks through the depths of the sea, and his speed is unknown even to the sun.

sanskrit_sloka: सर्वमुक्तंयथादिष्टंरावणेनदुरात्मना तंप्रापयन्तंवचनंतूर्णमाप्लुत्यवानराः प्रापद्यन्तदिवंक्षिप्रंलोप्तुंहन्तुंचमुष्टिभि:
sanskrit_prose: दुरात्मना: रावणेन: यथा: आदिष्टम् सर्वम् उक्तम् तम् वचनम् प्रापयन्तम् वानराः अप्लुत्य: तदा:: क्षिप्रम् लोप्तुम् मुष्टिभिः हन्तुंच: प्रापद्यन्त:
english_sloka: They will be filled with the Holy Spirit who gives them freedom, and they will be filled with joy when they come to the right hand of God.
english_prose: And when they had heard all that had been said, the foxes sounded and said, "In a little while we shall be consumed by the fleas".

sanskrit_sloka: एवमुक्त्वातुतंरामंसम्रब्धोवाहिनीपतिः वाक्यज्ञोवाक्यकुशलंततोमौनमुपागमत्
sanskrit_prose: वाहिनीपतिः वाक्यज्ञः सम्रब्ध: वाक्यकुशलम् तंरामम् एवम् उक्त्वा: ततः मौनम् उपागमत्
english_sloka: When the captain of the guard heard this, he was silent.
english_prose: When the centurion heard this, he shrugged his shoulders.

sanskrit_sloka: राक्षसस्सोऽपि तान्वन्यान्मृगान्मृगवधे रतः प्रच्छादनार्थं भावस्य न भक्षयति संस्पृशन्
sanskrit_prose: मृगवधे रतः सः राक्षसोऽपि वन्यान् तान् मृगान् संस्पृशन् भावस्य प्रच्छादनार्थम् न भक्षयति
english_sloka: Even the devils were not willing to feed them, so that they could spend the night in the dungeons of wild beasts.
english_prose: Even in the depths of the sea, he does not eat the animals he calls worms. He does not eat them in order to spread his love.

sanskrit_sloka: त्वत्कृते मे पिता वृत्तो रामश्चारण्यमाश्रितःअयशो जीवलोके च त्वयाऽहं प्रतिपादितः
sanskrit_prose: त्वत्कृते मे पिता वृत्तः रामश्च अरण्यम् आश्रितः त्वया अहम् जीवलोके अयशः च प्रतिपादितः
english_sloka: For you have made known to me the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy One, and of the living One, the Son and the Holy One.
english_prose: You made me a circle, a circle, a circle, a circle, a circle, a circle, a circle, a circle, a circle, a circle, a circle, a circle, a circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle, circle.

sanskrit_sloka: सर्वमेतद्विचेतव्यं यन्मया परिकीर्तितम्यदन्यदपि नोक्तं च तत्रापि क्रियतां मतिः
sanskrit_prose: मया यत् परिकीर्तिम् एतत् सर्वम् विचेतव्यम् अन्यदपि यत् नोक्तम् तत्रापि च मतिः क्रियताम्
english_sloka: All things should be done with caution, as I have ordered you to do, not only in this way but also in another way.
english_prose: You ought to consider all these matters carefully, and to do what I have already said and decided to do.

sanskrit_sloka: सा तु तत्रैव सम्भ्रान्ता सुव्रता वाक्यमब्रवीत्एकपत्नीव्रतमिदं को नाशयितुमिच्छति
sanskrit_prose: तत्रैव सम्भ्रान्ता सुव्रता सा तु वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् इदम् एकपत्नीव्रतम् कः नाशयितुम् इच्छति
english_sloka: The woman said to him, "Whoever has a wife should marry her?"

sanskrit_prose: कदाचित् अहमपि वीर्यात् इमाम् पृथिवीम् पर्यटन् नागसहस्रस्य बलम् धारयन् पर्वतोपमः नीलजीमूतसङ्काशः तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः किरीटी परिघायुधः लोकस्य भयम् जनयन् ऋषिमांसानि भक्षयन् दण्डकारण्ये व्यचरम्
english_sloka: I have walked the earth, and I have seen many dragons. I have seen mountains of blue, blue, purple, and green. I have been afraid of men. I have lived in depravity. I have lived in immorality. I have eaten the flesh of wild beasts.

sanskrit_prose: धर्मवत्सलः राघवः तां गदाम् बाणैः भित्त्वा स्मयमानः संरब्धम् खरम् इदं वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्

english_prose: The king's firstborn, whose name was Bala Ram, and his wife, Sita, committed a sinful act.

sanskrit_sloka: आज्ञाप्याथ यथाऽज्ञप्ति युक्तास्तेऽधिकृता नराःरमणीयेषु देशेषु बहुस्वादुफलेषु च यो निवेशस्त्वभिप्रेतो भरतस्य महात्मनःभूयस्तं शोभयामासुर्भूषाभिर्भूषणोपमम्
sanskrit_prose: अधिकृता ते नराः यथाज्ञप्ति युक्ताः आज्ञप्य अथ बहुस्वादुफलेषु रमणीयेषु देशेषु महात्मनः भरतस्य यः निवेशः अभिप्रेतः तम् भूषाभिः भूषणोपमम् भूयः शोभयामासुः
english_sloka: We have been obedient to the wisdom and wisdom of God and to the richness and splendor of the earth and to the abundance of the good things we have invested in you.
english_prose: The rulers of these nations, according to the word of the prophets, have given orders to the rich and prosperous land of the rich to invest in.

sanskrit_prose: विषये सती रामस्य साहाय्यम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि अथवा मैथिलीम् अक्लिष्टकारिणम् रामं च दृष्ट्वा ते वक्त्रम् आगमिष्यामि सत्यम् ते प्रतिशृणोमि
english_sloka: If you do, I will come to you with the help of Ramah and Mitylae, and I will tell them the truth.
english_prose: In this case, I will come and tell them the truth, and I will answer them.

english_sloka: This is why the king and his demons have authority to come to him in the synagogues.
english_prose: "The king was speechless, " he replied". I am not able to stand.

english_sloka: In addition, I would like to give a clear and thorough testimony to the work of the Spirit.

sanskrit_prose: तस्य इति ब्रुवाणस्य शुभलक्षणः सः लक्ष्मणः महात्मनः कबन्धस्य राघवम् शशंस

english_prose: He was greeted with the good news of his brilliance, and laid a wreath in the tomb of Laxman the Great.

sanskrit_sloka: मुहूर्तं भव सौमित्रे सीतायाः प्रत्यनन्तरःइमानस्या वधिष्यामि पदवीमागतानिह
sanskrit_prose: सौमित्रे मुहूर्तम् सीतायाः प्रत्यनन्तरः भव अस्याः पदवीम् इह आगतान् इमान् वधिष्यामि
english_sloka: I am going to say this to you, dear friends: I am going to graduate.
english_prose: I will give you this title as soon as you come to this place.

sanskrit_prose: ततः पुष्पातिभाराग्रान् लताशतसमावृतान् वासन्तिकान् द्रुमान् दृष्ट्वा भयशङ्किताः बभूवुः
english_sloka: When he saw them, he was amazed and amazed.

sanskrit_prose: वानराः मृत्युकालोपमस्य राजराजस्य सुग्रीवस्य आज्ञाम् श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवभयदर्शिनः आययुः

sanskrit_prose: भर्ता तस्या: हृदये द्विगुणम् परिवर्तते हृदयम् अन्तर्जातम् अपि हृदा व्यक्तम् आख्याति
english_sloka: And what is inside a person's heart is the same as what is inside a person's heart.
english_prose: The heart is a double heart. The heart is a double heart. The heart is also called the inner heart.

english_sloka: and thunderstorms in the valley, and thunderstorms in the wilderness, especially in places of unknown origin.
english_prose: And the king made a wise cattle in the wilderness; and he slew the wild goats in the wilderness.

english_prose: Rama Purandar: She: Fleshly and sexually, but spiritually, seven times divided.

sanskrit_prose: ततः सलक्ष्मणः सः रामः यूथपयूथसम्वृतः हरिवाहिनीपतिः विभीषणेन प्रतिनन्द्य सत्कृतः सुवेलपृष्ठे यथासुखम् न्यवसत्

sanskrit_sloka: राक्षसानां वधं कृत्वा सूदयित्वा च रावणम्लङ्कामुन्मूलितां कृत्वा कदा द्रक्ष्यति मां पतिः
sanskrit_prose: पतिः राक्षसानाम् वधम् कृत्वा रावणं च सूदयित्वा लङ्काम् उन्मूलिताम् कृत्वा माम् कदा द्रक्ष्यति

sanskrit_prose: पुरा सीतया सह अहम् यम् सदा सुखम् मन्ये सः मारुतः सीतां विना मम शोकं वर्धयते

english_sloka: They worked hard and worked tirelessly to overcome the temptation.

sanskrit_sloka: प्लवैः क्रौञ्चैश्च सम्पूर्णां महामृगनिषेविताम् अधिकं शोभते पम्पा विकूजद्भिःर्विहङ्गमैः दीपयन्तीव मे कामं विविधा मुदिता द्विजाः श्यामां चन्द्रमुखीं स्मृत्वा प्रियां पद्मनिभेक्षणाम्

sanskrit_prose: न: पिता धर्मात्मा स: पृथिवीपतिः दशरथ: शुभैः कृत्स्नैः आप्तदक्षिणैः क्रतुभिः स्वर्गं गतः
english_sloka: He was given a rightful place in heaven and a rightful place on earth.
english_prose: No, he is the Father of righteousness. He is the ruler of the earth.

sanskrit_sloka: यदि जीवति सा देवी ताराधिपनिभाननाआगमिष्यति साऽवश्यमिमां शिवजलां नदीम्
sanskrit_prose: ताराधिपनिभानना सा देवी जीवति यदि सा अवश्यम् इमाम् शिवजलाम् नदीम् आगमिष्यति
english_sloka: If she comes to the temple of the goddess of the living, she will go to the river Shiva.
english_prose: If the goddess is alive, she must come to the river Shivalam.

sanskrit_prose: महार्हशयनोचितः सः मेदिन्याम् संविश्य सौमित्रये शुभाः इमाः कथाः व्याजहार
english_sloka: Then he came to Medina and told the story of his friend Rama.
english_prose: My dear friend came to me and greeted me with these words.

sanskrit_sloka: ऋषिमध्ये स तेजस्स्वी प्रजापतिरिवापर: सृजन् दक्षिणमार्गस्थान् सप्तर्षीनपरान् पुन:नक्षत्रमालामपरामसृजत्क्रोधमूर्च्छित: दक्षिणां दिशमास्थाय मुनिमध्ये महायशा:
sanskrit_prose: ऋषिमध्ये स: तेजस्वी अपर: प्रजापति इव दक्षिणमार्गस्थान् अपरान् सप्तर्षीन् सृजन् ऋषिमध्ये क्रोधमूर्च्छित: दक्षिणां दिशम् आस्थाय महायशा: अपराम् नक्षत्रमालाम् असृजत्
english_sloka: In the midst of it there was a bright star, resplendent in brightness. On the right side of the road there were seven stars, seven seals of gold, and on the south side there was a great star.

sanskrit_prose: काकुत्स्थ त्वयि वर्षशतम् स्थिते परवान् अस्मि रुचिरे देशे क्रियताम् इति माम् वद

english_prose: Why don't you tell me that you've been here for a number of years and that you're willing to work hard for the country?

english_prose: All the monkeys wore her clothes and wept.

english_prose: When the king came to the place where he was going, he said to her, "This is a false witness.

sanskrit_prose: परन्तपः जीवलोकस्य रक्षिता स्वजनस्य अभिरक्षिता स्वस्य वृत्तस्य धर्मस्य च

english_sloka: For the raven is like a wolf in sheep's clothing, and the raven is like a wolf in sheep's clothing.
english_prose: Then the grass fell, and the wild beasts, and the wild beasts, and the wolves, and the leopards, and the beasts of the field.

sanskrit_prose: क्षमवताम् वर: तम् विभीषणम् रावणेन: प्रणितम् अवेहि: तस्य: निग्रहम् क्षमम् अहम् मन्ये:
english_sloka: I was afraid of her, and I was afraid of her, and I was afraid of her, and I was afraid of her, and I was afraid of her.

sanskrit_prose: महाभाग जनेश्वर भगीरथ ते सुतप्तेन तपसा अहम् प्रीत: सुव्रत वरम् वरय

sanskrit_sloka: क्षत्रियो याजको यस्य चण्डालस्य विशेषत:कथं सदसि भोक्तारो हविस्तस्य सुरर्षय:
sanskrit_prose: यस्य क्षत्रिय: याजक: विशेषत: चण्डालस्य तस्य सदसि सुरर्षय: हवि: कथम् भोक्तार:
english_sloka: and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest, and the lamp of the priest.
english_prose: and the priest, who is the head of the household, is the head of the household, and the head of the household is the head of the household.

sanskrit_sloka: सा नूनं जनकस्येष्टा सुता सुखसदोचिताकण्टकाक्रमणाक्लान्ता वनमद्य गमिष्यति
sanskrit_prose: सुखसदोचिता जनकस्य इष्टा सुता सा कण्टकाक्रमणक्लान्ता अद्य वनम् गमिष्यति
english_sloka: It is like a salt pan, but with salt and spices.
english_prose: The man who desires the good news will be like a hedgehog in the wilderness.

sanskrit_sloka: सर्वे सुकृतकर्माणस्सर्वे धर्मपरायणा: पशुभूता नरेन्द्रस्य तृप्तिमग्ने: प्रयच्छत
sanskrit_prose: सर्वे सुकृतकर्माण: सर्वे धर्मपरायणा: नरेन्द्रस्य पशुभूता: अग्ने तृप्तिम् प्रयच्छत
english_sloka: and to pursue every kind of good work with godly devotion.
english_prose: to do what is good, to fear God, to be self - controlled and to strive for what is good.

sanskrit_sloka: तेजोभिहतवीर्यत्वाज्जामदग्न्यो जडीकृत:रामं कमलपत्राक्षं मन्दं मन्दमुवाच ह
sanskrit_prose: तेजोभि: हतवीर्यत्वात् जडीकृत: जामदग्न्य: कमलपत्राक्षम् रामम् मन्दं मन्दम् उवाच ह
english_sloka: And they laid the foundations of stone upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it, and put it upon it.
english_prose: And they said unto him, Thou shalt do unto me as thou didst unto me: and thou shalt do unto me as thou didst unto me.

sanskrit_sloka: ततस्तुतेतस्यवधेनभूरिणामनस्विनोनैरृतराजबान्धवाः विनेदुरुच्चैर्व्यथितारघूत्तमंहरिंसमीक्ष्यैवयथासुरार्धिताः
sanskrit_prose: ततः नैरृतराजबान्दवाः भूरिणा मनस्विनः तस्य वधेन व्यथिताः हरिम् समीक्ष्यैव सुरार्धिताः यथा रघूत्तमम् उच्छैः विनेदुः
english_sloka: They held him in chains full of blood and blood. They held him in chains with their hands tied together and held him close to the threshing floor.
english_prose: The king's chains, made of stainless steel, stood in front of him. They looked as if they were shining bright red.

sanskrit_sloka: लक्ष्मणो हि महेष्वासो रामं सर्वात्मना गतःशत्रुघ्नश्चापि भरतं काकुत्स्थं लक्ष्मणो यथा
sanskrit_prose: महेष्वास: लक्ष्मण: सर्वात्मना रामम् गत: शत्रुघ्न: च अपि लक्ष्मण: काकुत्स्थं यथा भरतम्
english_sloka: Lakshmi is the majestic one, Rama is the one who has lost all his spirit, and Lakshmi is the one who has lost all his spirit.
english_prose: Maheshwas: Lakshman: Allmanana Rama Ghat: Enemyhaghan: also Lakshman: Kakutthas as Bharat

sanskrit_sloka: नय मां यत्र काकुत्स्थस्सीता यत्र च लक्ष्मणःतान्विना क्षणमप्यत्र जीवितुं नोत्सहेह्यहम्
sanskrit_prose: काकुत्स्थः सीता च यत्र लक्ष्मणः यत्र तत्र माम् नय तान् विना अत्र क्षणमपि जीवितुम् अहम् न उत्सहे
english_sloka: I do not want to live for a while in a place where you are united with me, and where you are united with me.
english_prose: I will not stay here a moment without them, except for the Feast of Unleavened Bread.

sanskrit_sloka: ततस्ताभिस्समेताभिर्नारीभिस्स महाबलः प्रसाद्य सहसा नीतो भवनं स्वं निशाचरः
sanskrit_prose: ततः महाबलः सः निशाचरः समेताभिः ताभिः नारीभिः प्रसाद्य सहसा स्वं भवनम् नीतः
english_sloka: He built a fortified manor house and built his own tabernacle.
english_prose: Then the mighty man went down to his house, with his bed full of women.

sanskrit_sloka: यदि त्वं प्रस्थितो दुर्गं वनमद्यैव राघवअग्रतस्ते गमिष्यामि मृद्नन्ती कुशकण्टकान्
sanskrit_prose: राघव अद्यैव त्वम् दुर्गम् वनम् प्रस्थितः यदि कुशकण्टकान् मृद्नन्ती ते अग्रतः गमिष्यामि
english_sloka: If the tower you are standing on is like a forest, and if you walk through it, I will go down to the valley of the shadow of death.
english_prose: Raguo, you are in the forests today; if the bushes are cut down, I will go before them.

sanskrit_sloka: दिव्यमस्ति न मे ज्ञानं नाभिजानामि मैथिलीम् यस्तां ज्ञास्यति तं वक्ष्ये दग्धस्स्वं रूपमास्थितः
sanskrit_prose: मे दिव्यम् ज्ञानम् नास्ति मैथिलीम् नाभिजानामि दग्धः स्वं रूम् आस्थितः ताम् यः ज्ञास्यति तम् वक्ष्ये
english_sloka: I don't know whether God is wise or not. He is like a burning bush in the bush.
english_prose: I don't know how to light a lamp. I don't know how to light a lamp.

sanskrit_sloka: सेतुरत्रयथाबध्येद्यथापश्येमतांपुरीम् तस्यराक्षसराजस्यतथात्वंकुरुराघव
sanskrit_prose: राघव: अत्र: सेतुः यथा: बध्येत्: तस्य: राक्षसराजस्य: ताम्: पुरीम्: यथा: पश्येमः तथा: त्वम्: कुरु:
english_prose: Ra'ah: Here: the bridge is as: Bhadith: his: Ra'ahsaras: tam: Purim: as: Pasheem and: tam: Kure:

sanskrit_sloka: स हि प्राप्तं न जानीते कालं कालविदां वरःविश्वामित्रो महातेजाः किं पुनर्यः पृथग्जनः
sanskrit_prose: कालविदाम् वरः महातेजाः सः विश्वामित्रः प्राप्त कालम् न जानीते यः पृथग्जनः किं पुनः
english_sloka: For it is not known how long it will take for him to return, but it is known how long it will take for him to return.
english_prose: The bride and groom are separated, and she does not know when she will return.

sanskrit_sloka: यस्यवाजेषुपवनःफलेपावकभास्करौ शरीरमाकाशमयंगौरवेमेरुमन्दरौ
sanskrit_prose: यस्य वाजेषु पवनः फले पावकभास्करौ गौरवे मेरुमन्दरौ शरीरम् आकाशमयम्
english_sloka: These are the flowers, the leaves, the leaves, the flowers, the leaves, the leaves, the flowers, and the seeds.
english_prose: These are the waters of the wind, the fruit of the earth, the flower of the earth, the glory of the sea, and the body of the heavens.

sanskrit_sloka: पापस्वभावश्चपलः कथं त्वं रक्षसां वर ऐश्वर्यमभिसम्प्राप्तो विमानमिव दुष्कृतिः
sanskrit_prose: रक्षसाम् वर पापस्वभावः चपलः त्वम् दुष्कृतिः विमानमिव ऐश्वर्यम् कथम् अभिसम्प्राप्तः
english_sloka: "Take care of your sinful nature and your sinful nature, for it is the power of God's Spirit to overcome you with wickedness.
english_prose: You are protected by your sinful nature and by the luxurious nature of your sinful nature.

sanskrit_sloka: राम शोकाभिभूतोऽहं शोकार्तानां भवान्गतिःवयस्य इति कृत्वा हि त्वय्यहं परिदेवये
sanskrit_prose: राम अहम् शोकाभिभूतः शोकार्तानाम् भवान् गतिः वयस्यः इति कृत्वा अहम् त्वयि परिदेवये
english_sloka: He said, "I'm sorry, but I'm going to be a joy to those who are grieving".
english_prose: "Ram, I am deeply saddened and saddened that you have come to our aid.

sanskrit_sloka: स वध्यमानः सुभृशं भुजाभ्यां परिरभ्यतौअप्रकम्प्यौ नरव्याघ्रौ रौद्रः प्रस्थातुमैच्छत
sanskrit_prose: वध्यमानः रौद्रः सः अप्रकम्प्यौ नरव्याघ्रौ तौ भुजाभ्याम् सुभृशम् परिगृह्य प्रस्थातुम् ऐच्छत
english_sloka: He was riding a fine grain of wheat on the ground, and there came up a dragon and a wolf.
english_prose: When the wheels of the rider came down, the tigers and the wild boars came down on their knees and made their way.

sanskrit_sloka: रामवाक्यमुपश्रुत्य हरयो जितकाशिनः पादपैरर्दयवनीरावानराःपरवाहिनीम्
sanskrit_prose: जितकाशिनः हरयः रामवाक्यम् उपश्रुत्य वीराः वानराः पादपैः परवाहिनीम् अर्धयन्
english_sloka: When they heard the word of God, their feet grew green, and their feet grew green.
english_prose: When the green seed heard the word of God, the mighty monkeys fell on their feet

sanskrit_sloka: ध्वजैर्विमथितैर्भग्नैःखङ्गैश्चविनिपातितैः रथैर्विध्वंसितैश्चापिपतितैःरजनीचरैः
sanskrit_prose: केचित् रजनीचरैः विमथितैः भग्नैः ध्वजैः विनिपातितैः खङ्गैश्च विध्वंसितैः रथैः पतितैः
english_sloka: Flags will fly, and blades will fall, and chariots will be destroyed.
english_prose: Some were killed by robbers, others by robbers, others by flags, others by guns, and others by chariots.

sanskrit_sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तदा वाली वचनं वानरेरितम्स महर्षिंतदाऽसाद्य याचते स्म कृताञ्जलिः
sanskrit_prose: तदा सः वाली वानरेरितम् एतत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा कृताञ्जलिः महर्षिम् सम् आसाद्य याचते स्म
english_sloka: When he heard this, he began to cry out to the Lord, saying,
english_prose: When he heard this, he asked for help.

sanskrit_sloka: तदस्त्रं तस्य वीरस्य स्वर्गमार्गप्रभावनम्रामबाणासनक्षिप्तमावहत्परमां गतिम्
sanskrit_prose: स्वर्गमार्गप्रभावनम् रामबाणा सनक्षिप्तम् तत् अस्त्रम् तस्य वीरस्य परमां गतिम् आवहत्
english_sloka: and his weapons of valour were swiftly propelled into the skies by the mighty winds of lightning.
english_prose: When the power of the heavenly way came to Ramaphosa, his weapon came quickly to his strength.

sanskrit_sloka: अतिकायोऽपितितेजस्वीराक्षसेन्द्रसुतस्तदा आरुरोहरथश्रेष्ठंश्रेष्ठस्सर्वधनुष्मताम्
sanskrit_prose: तदा अतितेजस्वी राक्षसेन्द्रसुतः सर्वधनुष्मताम् श्रेष्ठः अतिकायः रथश्रेष्ठम् आरुरोह
english_sloka: Because of this, the Son of Man has risen from the dead, and has become more and more obedient to God.
english_prose: He was stronger than all the horses, stronger than the chariots, and stronger than the horses.

sanskrit_sloka: जाम्बवान्यत्र नेता स्यादङ्गदश्च बलेश्वरःहनुमांश्चाप्यधिष्ठाता न तस्य गतिरन्यथा
sanskrit_prose: यत्र जाम्बवान् नेता स्यात् महाबलः अङ्गदश्च हनुमांश्च अधिष्ठाता तस्य गतिः अन्यथा न
english_sloka: The serpent is the ruler of the serpent, and the serpent is the ruler of the serpent.
english_prose: If a dragon were a ruler, he would be powerful and powerful, and his arms and hands might be stronger, he would not be able to move.

sanskrit_sloka: अथ सन्देहमानानां स्त्रीणां दृष्ट्वा च पार्थिवम्यत्तदाशङ्कितं पापं तस्य जज्ञे विनिश्चयः
sanskrit_prose: अथ पार्थिवम् दृष्ट्वा च सन्देहमानानाम् स्त्रीणाम् यत् तत् पापम् आशङ्कितम् तस्य विनिश्चय: जज्ञे
english_sloka: Because of this, the doubting women and the world's sinfulness made him aware of the sinfulness of his sinfulness.
english_prose: When the wicked woman saw the world, she doubted that she had sinned and was convinced that she had sinned.

sanskrit_sloka: एवं संविलपं स्तस्मिन्वने दशरथात्मजःददर्श महतीं पुण्यां पर्णशालां मनोरमाम् सालतालाश्वकर्णानां पर्णैर्बहुभिरावृताम्विशालां मृदुभिस्तीर्णां कुशैर्वेदिमिवाध्वरे शक्रायुधनिकाशैश्च कार्मुकैर्भारसाधनैःरुक्मपृष्ठैर्महासारै श्शोभितां शत्रुबाधकैः अर्क रश्मि प्रतीकाशैर्घोरैस्तूणीगतैश्शरैःशोभितां दीप्तवदनै स्सर्पैर्भोगवतीमिव महारजतवासोभ्यामसिभ्यां च विराजिताम्रुक्मबिन्दुविचित्राभ्यां चर्मभ्यां चापि शोभिताम् गोधाङ्गुळित्रैरासक्तैश्चित्रैः काञ्चनभूषितैःअरिसंघैरनाधृष्यां मृगै स्सिंहगुहा मिव
sanskrit_prose: एवम् संविलपन् दशरथात्मजः तस्मिन् वने महतीम् पुण्याम् मनोरमाम् सालतालाश्वकर्णानाम् बहुभिः मृदुभिः पर्णैः आवृताम् अध्वरे कुशैः तीर्णाम् विशालाम् वेदिमिव शक्रायुधनिकाशैः भारसाधनैः रुक्मपृष्ठैः महासारै: शत्रुबाधकैः कार्मुकैः शोभिताम् सर्पैः भोगवतीम् इव अर्करश्मिप्रतीकाशैः घोरैः दीप्तवदनैः तूणीगतैः शरैः शोभिताम् महारजतवासोभ्याम् असिभ्याम् विराजिताम् रुक्मबिन्दुविचित्राभ्याम् चर्मभ्याम् ताम् काञ्चनभूषितैः चित्रैः आसक्तै: गोधाङ्गुलित्रैः मृगैः सिंहगुहामिव अरिसङ्घै: अनाधृष्याम् पर्णशालाम् तस्मिन् वने ददर्श
english_sloka: And I saw a great circle of seven spirits. It was covered with gold leaf, gold leaf, and gold leaf, and silver leaf, and gold leaf, and silver leaf, and gold leaf, and silver leaf, and gold leaf, and gold leaf, and gold leaf, and gold leaf, and silver leaf, and gold leaf, and gold leaf, and silver leaf, and gold leaf, and gold leaf, and gold leaf.
english_prose: And there was in it a great multitude of spirits of gold, and gold, and gold, and gold, and silver, and gold, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver, and silver.

sanskrit_sloka: यच्चापि मन्येत भवान्महात्मास्त्रीघातदोषो न भवेत्तु मह्यम्आत्मेयमस्येति च मां जहि त्वंन स्त्रीवधस्स्यान्मनुजेन्द्रपुत्र
sanskrit_prose: मनुजेन्द्रपुत्र महात्मा भवान् मह्यम् स्त्रीघातदोषः न भवेत् मन्येत यच्च इयम् अस्य आत्मा इति माम् त्वम् जहि स्त्रीवधः न स्यात्
english_sloka: Nevertheless, I pray you, keep my soul from being blamed for the murder of a woman, and I pray you, son of a woman.

english_prose: The righteous king Darthath-Sopadhyay and Sabandhai were concerned about what they were doing.

sanskrit_sloka: कथञ्चिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम्इमं मुहूर्तं दुःखानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यसि भामिनि
sanskrit_prose: कथञ्चित् भवती दृष्टा परिशोचितम् कालः न भामिनि इमम् मुहूर्तम् दुःखानाम् अन्तम् द्रक्ष्यसि
english_sloka: For when you see this, you will be filled with sorrow, and the time will come when you will be filled with grief.
english_prose: Perhaps you will see the end of the tribulation that is ahead of you.

sanskrit_sloka: स गृहैरभ्रसङ्काशैः पाण्डुरैरुपशोभितम् राजमार्गं ययौ रामो मध्येनागरुधूपितम्
sanskrit_prose: सः रामः अभ्रसङ्कशै: पाण्डुरैः गृहैः उपशोभितम् अगरुधूपितम् राजमार्गं मध्येन ययौ
english_sloka: He built a house of bricks and made a road that led to Ramah.
english_prose: He went to Ram Abrasanksa: he went through the dirty highways, with his houses decorated with sand.

sanskrit_sloka: कबन्धानिसमुत्पेतुर्भीमाणांभीषणानिवै भुजपाणिशिरश्छिन्नकायाश्चभूतले वानराराक्षसाश्चापिनिपेतुस्तत्रवैरणे
sanskrit_prose: भीरूणाम् भीषणानि कबन्धानि भूतले समुत्पेतुः भुजपाणिशिरछशिन्नाः छिन्नकायाश्च वानराः राक्षसाश्चापि तत्र वैरणे निपेतुः
english_sloka: They were afraid of the tombs, afraid of the earthquakes, afraid of the waters, afraid of the waters, afraid of the waters, afraid of the devils, afraid of the devils.
english_prose: Fearful creatures were thrown into the tombs and into the depths of the earth. They were filled with locusts, locusts, snakes, and wild beasts.

sanskrit_sloka: विमाने भास्वरे तिष्ठन्हंसयुक्ते यशस्करेप्रभया च महातेजा दिशो दश विराजयन् सोऽन्तरिक्षगतो रामं कबन्धो वाक्यमब्रवीत्शृणु राघव तत्त्वेन यथा सीतामवाप्स्यसि
sanskrit_prose: सः कबन्धः अन्तरिक्षगतः हंसयुक्ते यशस्करे भास्वरे विमाने तिष्ठन् महातेजाः प्रभया दश दिशः विराजयन् रामम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् राघव सीताम् यथा अवाप्स्यसि तत्त्वेन शृणु
english_sloka: As they sat down in front of the Queen, they heard the sound of a roaring thunderstorm, like a roaring thunderstorm.
english_prose: And he heard the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah, and the voice of Ramah.

sanskrit_sloka: सश्रूत्वा तु पितरं वृत्तं भ्रातरौ च विवासितौभरतो दुःखसन्तप्त इदं वचनमब्रवीत्
sanskrit_prose: भरतः पितरम् वृत्तम् भ्रातरौ विवासितौ श्रुत्वा तु दुःखसन्तप्तः इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
english_sloka: When Peter and the brothers heard this, they were filled with grief.
english_prose: When the brothers heard about Peter, they were deeply saddened.

sanskrit_sloka: गतो दशरथस्स्वर्गं यो नो गुरुतरो गुरुःरामं प्रव्राज्य वै ज्येष्ठं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्
sanskrit_prose: यः नः गुरुतरः गुरुः दशरथः ज्येष्ठम् रामम् महाबलं च लक्ष्मणं च प्रव्राज्य स्वर्गम् गतः
english_sloka: He who ascended into the heavens is the greatest and most powerful, not only the greatest, but also the greatest.
english_prose: And he who is not greater than the Master, the Master, the Elder, the Great, the Great, the Powerful, and the Great, was taken up into heaven.

sanskrit_sloka: राघवस्तवसंयुक्तागगने च विशुश्रुवे साधुसाध्वितिवागग्य्रादेवतानांमहात्मनाम्
sanskrit_prose: महात्मनाम् देवतानाम् साधुसाधुइति राघवस्तवसंयुक्ता अग्य्रा वाक् गगने विशुश्रुवे च
english_sloka: Blessed are those who are filled with joy and gladness, who are filled with joy and gladness.
english_prose: And you will hear the sound of unquenchable flames from heaven, and you will hear the sound of unquenchable anger.

sanskrit_sloka: सुग्रीव श्रूयातां तात क्रोधश्च व्यपनीयताम्कारणं येन बाणोऽयं न मया स विसर्जितः
sanskrit_prose: तात सुग्रीव येन सः अयम् बाणः मया न विसर्जितः कारणम् श्रूयताम् क्रोधः व्यपनीयतां च
english_sloka: Do not be quick to listen, do not be angry, do not be discouraged.
english_prose: Make sure that he does not forget what I have said, so that I may hear him and be angry with him.

sanskrit_sloka: शेषं च हविषस्तस्य प्राश्याशास्यात्मनः प्रियम्ध्यायन्नारायणं देवं स्वास्तीर्णे कुशसंस्तरे वाग्यत स्सह वैदेह्या भूत्वा नियतमानसःश्रीमत्यायतने विष्णो श्शिश्ये नरवरात्मजः
sanskrit_prose: नरवरात्मजः आत्मनः प्रियम् आशास्य तस्य हविषः शेषं प्राश्य च देवम् नारायणम् ध्यायन् वाग्यतः भूत्वा नियतमानसः विष्णोः श्रीमति आयतने स्वास्तीर्णे कुशसंस्तरे वैदेह्या सह शिश्ये
english_sloka: And the rest of them, who have the gift of the Holy Spirit, who have loved the Lord, who have clothed themselves with God's anointing cloth, who have become witnesses of God's goodness, who have set their hearts on God's glory, who have set their hearts on God's glory, and who have set their hearts on God's glory.
english_prose: But when the spirit of man saw that he had no hope, and that he had no hope, he became angry with God.

sanskrit_sloka: स तस्यबाहुर्गिरिशृङ्गकल्पःसमुद्गरोराघवबाणकृत्तः पपाततस्मिन् हरिराजसैन्येजघानतांवानरवाहिनीं
sanskrit_prose: गिरिशृङ्गकल्पः समुद्गरः राघवबाणकृत्तः सः तस्यबाहुः तस्मिन् हरिराजसैन्ये पपात ताम् हरिवाहिनीं च जघान
english_sloka: His shoulders were made of bronze, and he threw them into the sea.
english_prose: He turned the sea into a raging sea of smoke. He took his hand and threw it into the sea.

sanskrit_sloka: जगदद्याभिषिक्तंत्वामनुपश्यतुराघव प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यंमध्याह्नेदीप्ततेजसम्
sanskrit_prose: राघव जगत् अद्य अभिषिक्तम् त्वाम् मध्याह्ने प्रतपन्तम् दीप्ततेजसम् आदित्यमिव अनुपश्यतु
english_sloka: We are the light of the world. We are the light of the world. We are the light of the world.
english_prose: "Today the Messiah will come to you in the midst of the day, and the light will shine on the earth.

sanskrit_sloka: इति प्रत्यर्च्य तान्राजा ब्राह्मणानिदमब्रवीत् वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च तेषामेवोपशृण्वताम्
sanskrit_prose: राजा इति तान् प्रत्यर्च्य तेषाम् उपशृण्वताम् एव वशिष्ठम् वामदेवं च ब्राह्मणान् इदम् अब्रवीत्
english_sloka: When the king heard this, he turned back and said, "The gods are on their knees and obey their voice".
english_prose: When he came to them and said, "King! " they were humbled, and the God of the West and the God of the Left stirred them up.

sanskrit_sloka: सुखानामुचितस्यैव दुःखैरनुचितस्य चदुखं नामानुपश्येयं कथं रामस्य धीमतः
sanskrit_prose: सुखानाम् उचितस्य दुःखैः अनुचितस्य च धीमतः रामस्य दुःखम् कथं नाम अनुपश्येयम्
english_sloka: He said, "It's not good, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, it's bad, and it's bad".
english_prose: Do not be ashamed of what is good or bad. Do not be ashamed of what is bad or bad.

sanskrit_sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वायमाकारंभजतेभरतस्ततः स च तेवेदितव्यःस्यात्सर्वंयच्छापिमांप्रति
sanskrit_prose: एतत् श्रुत्वा ततः भरतः यम् आकारम् भजते सः च ते वेदितव्यः मांप्रति यच्छापि स्यात् सर्वम्
english_sloka: When he said this, he and his disciples were overwhelmed with grief and asked, "What have you done for me?"
english_prose: When he heard this, he was filled with joy and said to them, "Whatever you want me to do for you, do for me".

sanskrit_sloka: स वानरसहस्राणां कोटीभिरभिसंवृतःक्षिप्रमेष्यति वैदेहि राक्षसानां निबर्हणः
sanskrit_prose: वैदेहि सः वानरसहस्राणाम् कोटीभिः अभिसंवृतः राक्षसानाम् निबर्हणः क्षिप्रम् एष्यति
english_sloka: He will hunt down thousands upon thousands of wild beasts and thousands upon thousands of birds.
english_prose: And he will come in a moment, and he will cast out thousands upon thousands of demons.

sanskrit_sloka: प्रष्टव्यो मेरुसावर्णिर्महर्षिः सूर्यसन्निभःप्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ प्रवृत्तिं मैथिलीं प्रति
sanskrit_prose: सूर्यसन्निभः महर्षिः मेरुसावर्णिः शिरसा भूमौ प्रणम्य मैथिलीं प्रति प्रवृत्तिम् प्रष्टव्यः
english_sloka: The sun was shining, and the sun was shining, and his head was turning toward the earth.
english_prose: The sun was shining brightly, and the clouds were raining, and the heads of the people were bowing down to the ground.

sanskrit_sloka: ततस्तांस्त्रीन्हतान्ज्ञात्वा वानरेण तरस्विना अभिपेदे महावेगः प्रसह्य प्रघसो हरिम्भासकर्णश्च सङ्कृद्धश्शूलमादाय वीर्यवान्
sanskrit_prose: ततः तरस्विना वानरेण तान् त्रीन् हतान् ज्ञात्वा प्रघसः महावेगः प्रसह्य अभिपेदे वीर्यवान् भासकर्णश्च सङ्कृद्धः शूलम् आदाय
english_sloka: The woman's body was given to her by the spirit of a serpent, a serpent of great beauty. She gave birth to a dragon, a serpent with rays of green and blue, and gave birth to a newborn child.
english_prose: When the dragon in Tarsus saw that they had been killed, he was furious, and threw himself into the sea with a spear and a horn.

sanskrit_sloka: स तांमातलिनानीतांशक्तिंवासवसम्मताम् जग्राहपरमक्रुद्धोराघवोरघुनन्दनः
sanskrit_prose: रघुनन्दनः सः राघवः परमक्रुद्धः मातलिना आनीताम् वासवसम्मताम् तांशक्तिम् जग्राह
english_sloka: He will bring the nations of the earth together, and they will cry out in the fury of God's wrath.
english_prose: They rejoiced, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, they were angry, and they were angry.

sanskrit_sloka: तानारुह्याथवा भूमौ पातयित्वा यथासुखम् फलान्यमृतकल्पानि लक्ष्मणस्ते प्रदास्यति
sanskrit_prose: लक्ष्मणः तान् आरुह्य अथवा यथासुखम् पातयित्वा अमृतकल्पानि फलानि ते प्रदास्यति
english_sloka: Then he took a thorn and threw it on the ground, and it sprouted, and it became as good as dead seed.
english_prose: When it is ripened and soaked, it yields deadly fruit.

sanskrit_sloka: स बद्ध इव पाशेन किशोरो मातरं यथाधर्मपाशेन सङ्क्षिप्तः प्रकाशं नाभ्युदैक्षत
sanskrit_prose: पाशेन बद्धः किशोरः इव सः धर्मपाशेन सङ्क्षिप्तः मातरं यथा प्रकाशम् नाभ्युदैक्षत
english_sloka: He was bound like a child in his lap, and his mother was like a thorn in the side of the right hand.
english_prose: He is like a young man bound on his shoulders. His feet are darkened, and his face is darkened like a cloud.

sanskrit_sloka: वैदेह्या यानि चाङ्गेषु तदा रामोऽन्वकीर्तयत्तान्याभरणजालानि गात्रशोभीन्यलक्षयत् सुकृतौ कर्णवेष्टौ च श्वदंष्ट्रौ च सुसंस्थितौमणिविद्रुमचित्राणि हस्तेष्वाभरणानि च श्यामानि चिरयुक्तत्वात्तथा संस्थानवन्ति च
sanskrit_prose: तदा रामः यानि आभरणजालानि वैदेह्याः अङ्गेषु अन्वकीर्तयत् गात्रशोभीनि तानि अलक्षयत् सुकृतौ कर्णवेष्टौ च सुसंस्थितौ श्वदंष्ट्रौ च हस्तेषु मणिविद्रुमचित्राणि आभरणानि च चिरयुक्तत्वात् श्यामानि संस्थानवन्ति च
english_sloka: In the plains of Bethesda there is a net of ram's oxen and goats. It is made of fine linen, fine linen, fine linen, fine linen, handkerchiefs, and wool.
english_prose: And he saw the web of fine linen, which he had made in the tents of Bethesda, and the fine linen of fine linen, and the fine linen of fine linen, and the fine linen of fine linen, and the fine linen of fine linen in their hands, and the linen of fine linen in their hands, and the linen of fine linen, and the linen of fine linen, and the linen of fine linen, and the linen of fine linen, and the linen of fine linen, and the linen of fine linen, and the linen of fine linen, and the linen of fine linen of fine linen, and the linen of fine linen of fine linen, and the linen of fine linen of fine linen, and the linen of fine linen of fine linen.

sanskrit_sloka: हरिपादविनिर्भग्नोनिषसाद स पर्वतः न शशाकतदात्मानंसोढुंभृशनिपीडितः
sanskrit_prose: हरिपादविनिर्भग्नः सःपर्वतः भृशपीडितः तदा आत्मानम् वोढुम् न शशाक निषसाद
english_sloka: He was driven to the mountains by the strong winds, and he was not allowed to climb mountains.
english_prose: When the sun came down on the mountain, the Spirit of God broke down on them, and they did not give up their spirits.

sanskrit_sloka: स सागरमनाधृष्यमभ्येत्य वरुणालयम्जगामाकाशमाविश्य वेगेन गरुडोपमः
sanskrit_prose: वेगेन गरुडोपमः सः अनाधृष्यम् वरुणालयम् सागरम् अभ्येत्य आकाशम् आविश्य जगाम
english_sloka: He was afraid of being thrown into the sea, but we saw an eagle flying into the sky.
english_prose: He was like an eagle, unwrapped in blood. He went down to the sea and was thrown into the sky.

sanskrit_sloka: लङ्काद्वीपस्यगोप्तारंकर्तारंभीमकर्मणाम् अस्माकंकामभोगानांदातारंरथिनांवरम्
sanskrit_prose: लङ्काद्वीपस्य गोप्तारम् भीमकर्मणाम् कर्तारम् अस्माकम् कामभोगानाम् दातारम् रथिनाम् वरम्
english_sloka: When we reached the shallow end of the island of Langka, we tried hard to land on the harbor.
english_prose: When we reached the shore of the island of Langka, we were shipwrecked.

sanskrit_sloka: एषातेहृदयंभित्त्वाशक्तिर्लोहितलक्षणा मद्भाहुपरिघोत्सृष्टाप्राणानादाययास्यति
sanskrit_prose: लोहितलक्षणा मद्भाहुपरिघोत्सृष्टा एषा शक्तिः ते हृदयम् भित्त्वा प्राणान् आदाय यास्यति
english_sloka: He is the one who gives life to the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, the sick, and the sick.
english_prose: It is more powerful than blood and blood, and it will break their hearts and kill their souls.

sanskrit_sloka: तव भ्रातुर्हि विख्यातस्सहायो रणकर्कशःरामः परबलामर्दी युगान्ताग्निरिवोत्थितः
